scope: Explicit native balloons linked to frozen Direct TechDraw BOM entries; addon only
numbering: Existing BOM Position; no automatic EBOM renumbering or drawing sequence

checks: Native adoption dialog selects an exact sorted frozen entry; expression displays BOM Position and retains leader/style
Adoption, table format and native properties undo/redo atomically
Previous addon rejects editing format 5 while embedded SVG remains native
Sort, translation, quantity and recreated EBOM UUIDs preserve the exact link and other tables
Failed table/balloon updates roll back their SVG, report and binding
Multiple balloons may reference one exact BOM entry
Native linked FCStd passes managed upload/reference integrity inspection
Native save/reopen/recompute retains frozen links offline and exports linked balloon text to PDF
Changed-revision entries become unresolved together with their table; undo/redo restores all linked numbers
Duplicate/split occurrences require explicit reconciliation; returning old rows never silently repairs a link
Deleted tables leave detectable orphan links; literal legacy balloons remain unadopted
ForgePDM PDF export accepts valid frozen links, rejects orphans before rendering and closes its isolated documents (fixture configuration opener)
native.scope: Disposable CAD only; no backend mutation; initial empty document/session state preserved

installed.callback_probe: Disposable managed metadata and temporary session placeholder; actual registered command dispatch intercepted before workflow execution; no HTTP calls; original empty/unauthenticated state restored

limits: Direct tables and explicit native balloon adoption only; Indented/Flattened links remain future work.
No automatic recognition, placement or geometry reattachment.
Renumbering/replacement/split/merge or changed duplicate sets require explicit reconciliation; unresolved links remain sticky.
The native PDF gate uses a fixture configuration opener; no HTTP publication was performed.
Native acceptance covers FreeCAD 1.1.4 / Qt 6.8.3 on this Linux workstation.
publication: Local installation; not committed or pushed
